rows.text: Accumulate heavy red devotion to draw massive hands with Clive, convert discards into lethal burn with Glint-Horn and Brallin, generate explosive mana as Ifrit, and finish games via damage multipliers or the Dualcaster-Twinflame combo.

guide.title: Devotion card draw and transforming into Ifrit

rows.name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant
rows.text: when Clive enters the battlefield, you may discard your hand, then draw cards equal to your devotion to red. For {4}{R}{R} and tapping Clive as a sorcery, exile him and return him transformed as Ifrit, Warden of Inferno. Ifrit's Chapter I fights target creature, while Chapters II and III add {R}{R}{R}{R} each. On Chapter III, exile Ifrit and return it front face up, re-triggering Clive's devotion hand refill.

cards.name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden of Inferno

rows.name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
rows.text: provides three red devotion pips and adds two additional damage to any red damage source you control.

rows.name: Fanatic of Mogis
rows.text: enters the battlefield and deals damage to each opponent equal to your devotion to red. With high devotion, this deals 10 to 15 direct damage to the table.

rows.name: Defiler of Instinct
rows.text: lets you pay two life instead of one red mana for red permanent spells while dealing one damage to any target on each red permanent cast.

rows.name: Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx
rows.text: taps for {2} to add red mana equal to your devotion to red, generating massive mana bursts.

rows.name: Nyx Lotus
rows.text: enters tapped and taps to add mana of one color equal to your devotion to that color.

rows.name: Roaming Throne
rows.text: choose Noble or Warrior on entry; doubles triggered abilities of that type, causing Clive to draw double your devotion when he enters.

rows.name: Glint-Horn Buccaneer
rows.text: deals one damage to each opponent whenever you discard a card. Pitching an eight-card hand to Clive burns each opponent for eight life.

rows.name: Brallin, Skyshark Rider
rows.text: puts a +1/+1 counter on itself and deals one damage to each opponent whenever you discard a card.

rows.name: Surly Badgersaur
rows.text: creates Treasures when you discard lands, puts counters on itself when you discard creatures, and fights opposing creatures when you discard noncreature nonlands.

rows.name: Terror of the Peaks
rows.text: deals damage equal to power whenever any creature enters the battlefield under your control.

rows.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
rows.text: indestructible enchantment that deals two damage to each opponent whenever any creature enters.

rows.name: Purphoros, Bronze-Blooded
rows.text: grants all creatures haste and lets you sneak large red creatures onto the battlefield from hand for {2}{R}.

rows.name: Solphim, Mayhem Dominus
rows.text: doubles all noncombat damage dealt by red sources you control.

rows.name: City on Fire
rows.text: triples all damage dealt by sources you control.

rows.name: Twinflame Tyrant
rows.text: doubles all damage dealt by sources you control to opponents and their permanents.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame
rows.text: cast Twinflame targeting any creature you control, leaving priority with Twinflame on the stack. Cast Dualcaster Mage with flash. When Dualcaster enters, target Twinflame with its copy ability. The copy of Twinflame targets Dualcaster Mage, resolving to create a hasty 2/2 token copy with haste. That token's entry trigger copies the original Twinflame again. Repeat for unbounded hasty 2/2 creatures to attack for the win.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Molten Duplication
rows.text: functions identically to Twinflame; creates unbounded artifact/creature copies with haste.

rows.name: Underworld Breach + Jeska's Will + Wheel of Fortune
rows.text: cast spells from graveyard using escape; Jeska's Will provides massive red mana and cards while Wheel of Fortune stocks the graveyard with escape fuel to assemble lethal burn or combo pieces.

rows.name: Treasonous Ogre
rows.text: pays three life for each {R}, converting surplus life into immediate mana to cast Clive or execute combo turns.

rows.name: Jeska's Will
rows.text: premium red ritual and card advantage engine scaling off opponents' hands.

rows.name: The One Ring
rows.text: grants protection from everything upon casting and draws exponential cards each turn.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: zero-mana redirection spell while controlling Clive to protect him from targeted removal.

rows.name: Bolt Bend
rows.text: one-mana redirection spell when controlling a creature with power four or greater.

rows.name: Blasphemous Act
rows.text: one-mana board wipe to clear opposing boards before deploying your commander.

Keep opening hands with two to three lands, early mana acceleration (Sol Ring, Ruby Medallion, rituals), and red devotion permanents. Deploy permanents with dense red pips in the first few turns to establish board presence and devotion, then resolve Clive to refill your hand with six to ten new cards. Protect your board and resolve combo lines or damage multipliers on Turn 6 or later.
House rules apply: infinite combo loops and compact wins are restricted to Turn 6 or later. Earlier turns focus on establishing board presence, card advantage, and devotion.
